summary: Umpqua NF lookout on Abbott Butte, Douglas County OR: 1928 D-6 cupola house, then an L-4 tower (1938 or 1939); collapsed 2021-22; remains burned; wilderness, on foot only.

facts.design: 20-ft sawn fir timber tower with L-4 14x14 cab (built 1938 or 1939); earlier 1928 D-6 cupola house
facts.status_note: Cab collapsed after 2015, then the tower over winter 2021-22; the Forest Service reportedly burned the remains

access.note: Inside the Rogue-Umpqua Divide Wilderness since 1984; vehicle access closed; reached on foot

visit.trail_note: No tower to climb. A 2023 hiker found the trail did not seem to be maintained and was overgrown.

events.note: George Barrows named as lookout on Abbott Butte in an August 1927 newspaper report, which says he helped a packer carry lookout house materials from Woodruff Meadows
D-6 cupola-style lookout house erected; firelookout.com says it sat on a 15-foot tower
20-ft sawn fir timber tower with L-4 14x14 cab; Forest Lookouts dates it 1938 from an undated report, firelookout.com says 1939
Mr. and Mrs. Delbert Poole spent the summer at Abbott Butte; Mr. Poole named as Forest Service lookout, August 1940 Roseburg paper
Area designated wilderness (Rogue-Umpqua Divide Wilderness) with all vehicle access closed
Tower collapsed, probably over winter 2021-22 (exact time unclear per Every Lookout); collapse reported in a November 2022 post; cause not given; remains reportedly burned

corrections.proposed: 20-ft sawn fir timber tower with L-4 14x14 cab (built 1938 or 1939); earlier 1928 D-6 cupola house
corrections.why: D-6 is the design of the 1928 cupola lookout house. The tower that stood later carried an L-4 cab, per Forest Lookouts and firelookout.com.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Forest Lookouts gives 1938, from an undated report. firelookout.com gives 1939. The story gives both and says the sources differ.

notes_for_editor: The 1938 vs 1939 date for the L-4 tower is unresolved: Forest Lookouts relies on an undated report, firelookout.com says 1939. A Library of Congress record for the Abbott Butte Fire Lookout Complex (loc.gov/item/or0644/) looked likely to settle the date and the D-6 design, but the fetch returned HTTP 403, so it is not used. The tower fate and burning are reported by two sources and are high confidence. The 2022 date is the report date; the collapse itself happened over winter 2021-22, exact time unclear. The 2022 event was changed from destroyed to other because no cause is given. No photos added: the firelookout.com photos are credited to other collections and no image URLs or license were read. Access rests on the wilderness designation and a 2023 hike report; no current site description was found. Fact-check 2026-10-10: wording of the 1927 packing, 1940 Poole visit (Mr. and Mrs.), winter collapse timing and the current-state claims was corrected to match the sources.
